template: FreeSurfer fsaverage5, left and right hemispheres
atlas: Destrieux 2009 surface atlas; Desikan-Killiany entorhinal parcel; FreeSurfer aseg Left-Hippocampus (17) and Right-Hippocampus (53); mPFC from HCP-MMP1 (Glasser et al. 2016)
transform: Each hemisphere is centered on its own pial bounding box and uniformly scaled; frame.center and frame.scale in each asset recover surface RAS (= display * scale + center), so the viewer can place both hemispheres together. Hippocampus converted with aseg vox2ras_tkr and the same hemisphere pial transform. Only the folded pial surface is exported; there are no inflated coordinates.
same_template_check: Nilearn pial coordinates and topology exactly match the FreeSurfer fsaverage5 reference pial in each hemisphere.

regions.vmpfc: Approximate lower medial prefrontal neighborhood: Destrieux rectus (31), subcallosal (32), medial orbital/olfactory sulcus (64), suborbital sulcus (71), and lower anterior cingulate (6; surface RAS z < 10 mm). Includes medial OFC; not an exclusively orbital label.
regions.acc: Anterior cingulate entry: Destrieux anterior midcingulate (7, G_and_S_cingul-Mid-Ant) plus the dorsal part of Destrieux anterior cingulate (6, G_and_S_cingul-Ant): its vertices that Desikan-Killiany labels superiorfrontal or caudalanteriorcingulate. Drops the pregenual/subgenual wrap around the genu (DK rostralanteriorcingulate and medialorbitofrontal). Not presented as the study lesion mask. Regions may overlap; the viewer colors one at a time.
regions.mpfc: Medial prefrontal cortex between ACC and vmPFC: HCP-MMP1 (Glasser et al. 2016) pregenual areas a24, p24, p32 and d32 on fsaverage (first 10242 vertices = fsaverage5). Destrieux Medial_wall vertices excluded. Overlaps vmpfc and acc in places.
regions.insula: Anterior insula guide: Destrieux short insular gyri (18, G_insular_short) and anterior circular sulcus (48, S_circular_insula_ant). Excludes long insular gyri and the full superior/inferior circular sulci.
regions.ec: Dedicated Desikan-Killiany entorhinal parcel (index 6); 48 left and 42 right fsaverage5 vertices; not the whole parahippocampal parcel.
regions.hc: Matching fsaverage5 aseg label 17 (Left-Hippocampus) or 53 (Right-Hippocampus). Gaussian sigma 0.65 voxel, marching cubes at 0.5; display smoothing only.
